_README: Lab-only endpoint photometry for the pilot displays. Measured with a Minolta spot photometer, screen normal, central patch, same room lighting as the sessions, >=15 min warm-up, patch = 2.0 cm square via analysis/photometry_target.html. Units: cd/m^2. Canonical stimulus endpoints (used by weibull_analysis.py --photometry): L_white_cd_m2 = white patch on black (pixel 255, the RDK dot), L_black_cd_m2 = full black field (pixel 0, the RDK background, no glare). Extra panel-characterisation fields: L_black_bright_surround_cd_m2 = black patch on white (black floor lifted by veiling glare/scatter from bright surround), L_white_field_cd_m2 = full white field (checks auto-brightness-limiting / white clipping). This characterises the lab Mac-vs-Dell comparison only; online Prolific participants run on uncalibrated consumer displays and are NOT covered by this file. Dots = #ffffff (white), background = #000000 (black).

Dell-2209WA.note: External secondary LCD used for translation + rotation (and the Monday spiral/translation replicate).
Dell-2209WA.brightness_setting: Fixed lab setting, measured 2026-08-03; REFERENCE display for all runs going forward. (Day-1 translation/rotation were on this Dell; brightness assumed unchanged but not independently verified.)

Mac-Retina-builtin.note: Built-in MacBook Retina panel used for the Saturday spiral run AT THE 'NORMAL' BRIGHTNESS SETTING (not photometered; value unknown). The luminances below were read on 2026-08-03 at MAX brightness, which is NOT the data-collection condition, so the canonical endpoints are left null and the max readings are stored separately as panel metadata. Decision: Mac retired in favour of the Dell as the reference display; the Monday Dell spiral+translation replicate resolves the display/day confound directly, so the Saturday Mac luminance no longer needs to be recovered.
Mac-Retina-builtin.brightness_setting: Saturday spiral: macOS 'normal' (unknown). Readings below: MAX.
